markdown-editor-placement.failing: the neighbour overlap assertion, awaiting approval

command-management-dialog.failing: the error wording for a rejected delete; no file on that path was touched in this run
command-management-dialog.precondition: this spec dies at waitForTerminal when the workspace has no tab

regression.note: 975 rather than 972 because three unit tests were added

final_round_fixes.what: the orphan report fired on every commit while the tab was gone, so any transition out of floating was undone - 최대화 and 터미널 채움 were inert on an orphaned window, against FR-MDE-001 AC-1/AC-2/AC-3. It now reports once per window and the set is pruned with the windows

a tray revival of an orphaned window set the workspace's activeTabId to a deleted tab, blanking the terminal and hiding every other window in that workspace. The revival now selects only a tab that still exists
raiseDialogById took a DialogMode, so raising a modal type-checked and would have moved the focus trap. The parameter is 'modeless'
the id search took the first match, which is the backmost dialog. It runs from the front
three unit tests added for the two new pure rules - raiseDialogById and term 4's orphan escape

programmatic_raise.what: reopening an open file and reviving from the tray both raise the window; both were placeholders reading 'raising is T-PH007-08's'
programmatic_raise.how: raiseDialogById names the dialog by the id its host already knows, so the token never leaves useDialogStack
programmatic_raise.closed: markdown-editor-entry.spec.ts FR-MDE-007 reopen, which had been red

mutants.mutation: raiseDialogById finds the entry but does not raise
the orphan report guarded by placement rather than by having reported

reported_not_fixed.what: tabClosed on the visibility predicate is optional and defaults to the answer that loses a window. The only thing optionality buys is not editing an existing test factory; there is exactly one caller and it passes the flag
resolveTabSession(...) === undefined is now spelled out in three places across two files. EditorWindowRenderContext could carry tabClosed and the two recomputations could go
editorWindowDialogId sits in the component module, which the unit suite cannot import, so the id rule has no unit test
two windows orphaned before either was drawn both fall back to the stage rect and overlap exactly
deleting a workspace removes its tabs, so every window in it is rewritten to floating while off screen
a layer remount before the orphan applies loses the inherited rect and falls back to the stage
revive uses a non-functional setWindows built from a captured value
